proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman to be an Independent Director whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Humanitarian Risks Due to Climate Change Policies
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit analyzing economic and humanitarian effects of JPM's climate transition policies on emerging nations, published as a report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Indigenous Peoples' Rights Indicators
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the effectiveness of policies and performance indicators for respecting Indigenous Peoples' rights in corporate and project financing.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proxy Voting Alignment
proposals.proponent: The Maryknoll Sisters of St. Dominic, Inc.
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a review of JPMAM's 2023 proxy voting record and voting policies on diversity and climate change, with a report to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Due Diligence in Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas
proposals.proponent: Sisters of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Aberdeen, South Dakota
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report on JPMC's due diligence on human rights and material risks in conflict-affected and high-risk areas.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Opportunity to Vote on Excessive Golden Parachutes
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy to seek shareholder approval of NEO pay packages with golden parachute payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target bonus.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Respecting Workforce Civil Liberties
proposals.proponent: Bowyer Research Inc. on behalf of The Bahnsen Family Trust Dated July 14th 2003
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an evaluation and report on how Chase's policies affect employees based on religious or political views and the associated business risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
